name: nexusreach-crm
description: Open-Source Multichannel CRM & High-Volume Outreach Engine with Multi-Provider Mailbox Rotation, Hostinger API, and WhatsApp Automation

scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
